blocker_summary: The frozen Phase A producer (57dfcb72...) hard-rejects every h95-* case ID at admission (commit ce7eedf), deferring to a 'separate, explicitly authorized path' that did not exist anywhere in the producer tree, the InferSwarm repo, or any branch at freeze time. Executing Phase B on that producer was impossible without violating the producer freeze; decrypting h95 with no execution machinery would have consumed the single-use holdout without producing evidence. Stopped before decrypt; no plaintext revealed; no h95 case executed.

phase_a_producer.role: calibration producer (c95/p95 only); immutable historical identity
phase_a_producer.change_scope: none; every frozen inferswarm_97 file remains byte-identical (sha256 asserted below and by the Phase B test suite)

phase_b_producer.role: holdout-only execution authority: h95 admission entrypoints + equivalence tests; adds ZERO execution/model math
phase_b_producer.requirement: every participating worktree must be clean and exactly at commit before any runtime/CUDA initialization
phase_b_producer.design: Holdout-only entrypoints in a NEW benchmarks/inferswarm_97b/ package accept exactly the 24 committed h95 cell IDs (public commitment identities) and delegate to the frozen Phase A runner main() with ONLY the module-level admission callable swapped (h95-only in; c95/p95 rejected; unknown/substituted/duplicate holdout IDs rejected). All execution, model math, topology, capture, teacher-forcing, and evidence contracts are the byte-identical frozen Phase A code.
phase_b_producer.equivalence_proof: 13-test CPU-only suite (tests/research/test_inferswarm_97b_holdout_authority.py): (1) every Phase A frozen file byte-identical to its 57dfcb7 sha256; (2) admission accepts exactly the 24 committed cells, rejects calibration/historical/unknown/substituted/duplicate/non-dict; (3) each entrypoint executed as __main__ delegates to the frozen main with only the admission swapped and propagates its exit code (sentinel rc=7); (4) Phase A package admission unaffected by import or entrypoint run; (5) source audit: 97b imports no torch/freetoken/76-harness and contains no model/runtime calls. Synthetic fixtures only; no secret material.

holdout_admission.accepted_case_ids: exactly the 24 committed sealed-holdout-commitment cells (one per population cell)
holdout_admission.rejected: all c95-*/p95-* calibration, c74/c86/p76/p86/h86 historical, unknown/renumbered/substituted h95 IDs, duplicates, non-dict rows
holdout_admission.fails_closed_before: CUDA initialization, model loading, any correctness-bearing execution

tests.phase_a_suite_still_green: tests/research/test_inferswarm_97_harness.py (10 tests) — green on the same tree
tests.ci: FreeToken repository defines no branch/PR test workflow (release/nightly only); no checks run on inferswarm-97-v4-physical-qualification at either 57dfcb7 or c60a4b7. Qualification evidence is the locally executed suites above.
